findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_planning_calculation, get_course, get_my_feedback, get_occupation_courses, get_planning_calculation, get_rto, get_rto_regulatory_actions, get_visa_case, list_advisors, open_application_form · Private data: create_planning_calculation, create_planning_dossier, get_my_feedback, get_planning_calculation, get_planning_dossier, get_planning_input_options, get_planning_schema_definition, get_planning_schema_index, get_state_dama_agreements, get_state_nomination, get_state_nomination_detail, get_state_nomination_occupations, get_visa_condition, list_planning_calculations, list_planning_dossiers, open_application_form · Public sink: list_advisors, open_application_form · Destructive: get_planning_input_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_planning_calculation, get_course, get_my_feedback, get_occupation_courses, get_planning_calculation, get_rto, get_rto_regulatory_actions, get_visa_case, list_advisors, open_application_form · Private data: create_planning_calculation, create_planning_dossier, get_my_feedback, get_planning_calculation, get_planning_dossier, get_planning_input_options, get_planning_schema_definition, get_planning_schema_index, get_state_dama_agreements, get_state_nomination, get_state_nomination_detail, get_state_nomination_occupations, get_visa_condition, list_planning_calculations, list_planning_dossiers, open_application_form · Public sink: list_advisors, open_application_form · Destructive: get_planning_input_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_course" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read CRICOS course topics by code or URL. Defaults to core. Explicit nonempty sections replace the default: core, overview, fees, requirements, intakes, campuses, pathways, packages, similar. Topic options must be nested under their selected section. Full semantic entries are preserved; subsequent p" → after: "Read CRICOS course topics by code or URL. Defaults to core. Explicit nonempty sections replace the default: core, overview, fees, requirements, intakes, campuses, pathways, packages, similar, majors. Majors are directions within this CRICOS course; a listed option does not imply compulsory selection"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
